subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw require exact current-main vLLM gpt-oss stream proof before accepting any recovery path that could reclassify assistant text as executable tool calls?
rationale: The reduced stream shape appears handled by current source, while the proposed recovery crosses the tool-execution boundary and needs maintainer judgment if exact provider proof remains unavailable.

options.title: Require exact stream proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

options.title: Sponsor provider-specific recovery
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned vLLM/gpt-oss recovery design with explicit false-promotion tests and security review if exact reproduction is impractical.

options.title: Defer to adjacent no-finish work
options.body: Treat this as blocked behind the no-finish stream decision only if maintainers determine the reported finish_reason evidence is not reliable.

recommendation.title: Require exact stream proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

likelyOwner.reason: The current parser branch and adjacent tests are attributed to this person in focused blame, making them the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency call.
